arxiv-2211-08317.title: The logic of quantum mechanics incorporating time dimension
arxiv-2211-08317.creator: Ivan Chajda, Helmut Länger
arxiv-2211-08317.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ivan Chajda, Helmut Länger. Similarly as classical propositional calculus is based algebraically on Boolean algebras, the logic of quantum mechanics was based on orthomodular lattices by G. von Neumann [ 3 ] and K. However, this logic does not incorporate time dimension although it is apparent that the propositions occurring in the logic of quantum mechanics are depending on time.

arxiv-2307-16646.title: Constraining a companion of the galactic center black hole, Sgr A*
arxiv-2307-16646.creator: Clifford M. Will 1,2 , Smadar Naoz 3,4 , Aurélien Hees 5 , Alexandria Tucker 1,6,7 , Eric Zhang 8 , Tuan Do 3 , Andrea Ghez 3
arxiv-2307-16646.description: Abstract We use 23 years of astrometric and radial velocity data on the orbit of the star S0-2 to constrain a hypothetical intermediate-mass black hole orbiting the massive black hole Sgr A* at the Galactic center. The data place upper limits on variations of the orientation of the stellar orbit at levels between 0.02 0.02 and 0.07 0.

arxiv-2311-09162.title: Leaving No Branches Behind: Predicting Baryonic Properties of Galaxies from Merger Trees Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2311-09162.creator: Chen-Yu Chuang, Christian Kragh Jespersen, Yen-Ting Lin, Shirley Ho, Shy Genel
arxiv-2311-09162.description: Abstract Galaxies play a key role in our endeavor to understand how structure formation proceeds in the Universe. For any precision study of cosmology or galaxy formation, there is a strong demand for huge sets of realistic mock galaxy catalogs, spanning cosmologically significant volumes.

arxiv-2410-00440.title: Beamsplitter-free, high bit-rate, quantum random number generator based on temporal and spatial correlations of heralded single-photons
arxiv-2410-00440.description: Abstract The spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC), an inherently random quantum process, produces non-deterministic photon-pair with strong temporal and spatial correlations owing to both energy and momentum conservation. Therefore, the SPDC-based photon pairs are used for quantum random number generation (QRNG).

arxiv-2412-00204.title: MeerKAT discovery of GHz radio emission extending from Abell 3017 toward Abell 3016
arxiv-2412-00204.creator: Dan Hu, Norbert Werner, Haiguang Xu, Qian Zheng, Jean-Paul Breuer, Linhui Wu, Stefan W. Duchesne, Reinout J. van Weeren, Ming Sun, Congyao Zhang, Melanie Johnston-Hollitt, Huanyuan Shan, Quan Guo, Zhenghao Zhu, Jingying Wang, Junhua Gu, Yuanyuan Zhao, Hoongwah Siew, Junjie Mao, Zhongli Zhang, and To
arxiv-2412-00204.description: Abstract Context. Cosmic filaments are vast, faint structures that connect galaxy clusters, often challenging to detect directly. However, filaments between pre-merger cluster pairs become more visible due to gas heating and compression while the clusters are approaching, enabling detection in X-ray and radio wavelengths. The clusters Abell 3017 and Abell 3016 are located within such a large-scale filament.

arxiv-2510-06511.title: Appearance of the higher-order Stokes phenomenon in a discrete Airy equation
arxiv-2510-06511.creator: Aaron J. Moston-Duggan, Christopher J. Howls, Christopher J. Lustri
arxiv-2510-06511.description: Abstract We study a discrete variant of the Airy equation, formulated as an advance-delay equation, to reveal that discretization induces the higher-order Stokes phenomenon, which is not present in the continuous Airy function and is typically only encountered in solutions to third-order or higher linear homogeneous, or nonlinear, differential equations.

pmc-10650893.title: Genome Analysis of Thinopyrum intermedium and Its Potential Progenitor Species Using Oligo-FISH
pmc-10650893.creator: Fei Qi, Shuang Liang, Piyi Xing, Yinguang Bao, Richard R-C Wang, Xingfeng Li, Chunli Chen, Xianhong Ge
pmc-10650893.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The genome composition of intermediate wheatgrass (IWG) is complex and continues to be a subject of investigation. In this study, molecular cytogenetics were used to investigate the karyotype composition of Th. intermedium and its relative diploid species. St2-80 developed from Pseudowroegneria strigose and pDb12H developed from Dasypyrum breviaristatum were used as probes in fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) to classify the chromosomes of Th. intermedium into three groups, expressed as JvsJvsJrJrStSt.

pmc-11438001.title: A urine-based liquid biopsy for detection of upper tract urothelial carcinoma: a self-matched study
pmc-11438001.creator: Wei Wei, Panhong Fan, Zhishu Zhang, Danting Wu, Junfeng Liu, Lingdian Wang, Xiaoyu Duan, Xiaoli Zhang, Degang Ding
pmc-11438001.description: BackgroundTo establish the pathological diagnosis of UTUC before treatment is profitable. At present, the conventional pathological diagnostic methods have certain problems. Besides, the urine-based DNA methylation test have been already utilized to detect bladder cancer.ObjectiveTo evaluate the sensitivity and specificity of DNA methylation plus 17 genes mutation test and compare the combined test with cytology.

pmc-12528448.title: Resistance to CDK7 inhibitors directed by acquired mutation of a conserved residue in cancer cells
pmc-12528448.creator: Chun-Fui Lai, Victoria I Cushing, Ellen Olden, Charlotte L Bevan, R Charles Coombes, Basil J Greber, Laki Buluwela, Simak Ali
pmc-12528448.description: CDK7 has emerged as a cancer target because of its pivotal roles in cell cycle progression and transcription. Several CDK7 inhibitors (CDK7i) are now in clinical evaluation. Identifying patients most likely to respond to treatment and early detection of tumour evolution towards resistance are necessary for optimal implementation of cancer therapies.

pmc-12610613.title: DB-YOLO: A Dual-Branch Parallel Industrial Defect Detection Network
pmc-12610613.creator: Ziling Fan, Yan Zhao, Chaofu Liu, Jinliang Qiu
pmc-12610613.description: Insulator defect detection in power inspection tasks faces significant challenges due to the large variations in defect sizes and complex backgrounds, which hinder the accurate identification of both small and large defects. To overcome these issues, we propose a novel dual-branch YOLO-based algorithm (DB-YOLO), built upon the YOLOv11 architecture.

pmc-13157407.title: A Decolonial Lexicon for Immunology
pmc-13157407.creator: Claudio Vieira da Silva
pmc-13157407.description: The discipline of immunology has historically been foundationally framed by metaphors of war, portraying the body as a sovereign state defending its territory against foreign invaders. This paradigm, however, is not strictly a biological necessity but also a historical artifact of colonial logic that arguably limits our understanding of symbiosis, tolerance, and the nature of relational pathologies.

pmc-13410878.title: Biocompatibility Assessment of a Hybrid Material Based on Epoxy-Treated Pericardium and Polyvinyl Alcohol Cryogel in a Rat Vascular and Subcutaneous Implantation Model
pmc-13410878.creator: E.A. Ovcharenko, T.V. Glushkova, E.A. Senokosova, K.Yu. Klyshnikov, T.N. Akentieva, A.A. Klyueva, A.V. Mironov, A.E. Kostyunin
pmc-13410878.description: The aim of the study was to evaluate the biocompatibility of a hybrid material based on epoxy-treated bovine pericardium and cryostructured polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) after implantation into the rat aortic wall and subcutaneous tissue.Materials and MethodsThe study evaluated hybrid material patches based on epoxy-treated bovine pericardium and cryostructured PVA; unmodified “KemPeriplasNeo” pericardial patches served as controls.

pmc-13688969.title: The experience of setting up midwife-led birth centers in Pakistan: a case study
pmc-13688969.creator: Razia Naveed, Zainab Khawaja, Adnan Ahmad Khan, Tazleem Ayaz, Hania Rehman, Saad Ibrahim Rasheed, Ayza Sadaf Khawaja, Kirsty Hughes, Oliva Bazirete, Sofia Castro Lopes, Sabera Turkmani, Andrea Nove, Mandy Forrester, Caroline S. E. Homer
pmc-13688969.description: IntroductionMidwife-led birth centers (MLBCs) exist in Pakistan in various financial and operational capacities. Some operate independently, providing maternity services for a small user fee. Others operate through public-private partnerships involving collaboration between the government and NGOs. Currently, there is insufficient evidence available on the experiences of community midwives as maternal health care providers in MLBCs.
